subject: ela
intro: Pick how the picture goes with the fact.

items.prompt:
Fact: 'A butterfly has colorful wings.' The picture would show:
A) A plain gray rock
B) A butterfly with colorful wings
C) A car
items.answer: B) A butterfly with colorful wings

steps: Match the fact. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) A butterfly with colorful wings

items.prompt:
Fact: 'A fish has fins.' The picture would show:
A) A fish with fins
B) A bird
C) A tree

steps: Match the fact. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Photo: a red apple. Fact: 'Apples can be red.' They:
A) Match
B) Do not match
C) Are about dogs

steps: Red apple matches. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Photo: a sunny beach. Which fact does NOT match?
A) The sun is out
B) It was snowing hard
C) People swim here

steps: Sunny beach is not snow. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Fact: 'A spider spins a web.' The picture would show:
A) A spider on a web
B) A dog
C) A boat
items.answer: A) A spider on a web

steps: Match the fact. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) A spider on a web

items.prompt:
A photo of plant steps (seed, sprout, plant) best matches the words:
A) Plants grow in steps
B) Cars are fast
C) Fish swim

steps: Photo shows the steps. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Fact: 'Bees have yellow and black stripes.' The picture would best show:
A) A plain brown bug
B) A bee with yellow and black stripes
C) A red ladybug
items.answer: B) A bee with yellow and black stripes

steps: Match the details. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) A bee with yellow and black stripes

items.prompt:
Why does a fact book include pictures or photos?
A) To hide the facts
B) To help us see and understand the facts
C) To make it heavier
items.answer: B) To help us see and understand the facts

steps: Images support the words. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) To help us see and understand the facts
